test_document_retrieval: test the GENRE model to retrieve relevant Wikipedia pages for a given input sentence
run_GENRE_sample: run the GENRE model sample method with a prefix-allowed tokens function to retrieve documents
load_Trie_from_dict: load a Trie prefix tree from a pickled dictionary file for constrained decoding
load_GENRE_from_pretrained: load a pretrained GENRE model from a local directory using GENRE.from_pretrained
review_test_example_document_retrieval: review the test_example_document_retrieval function to understand how GENRE integrates with a Trie for document retrieval
